title_en: Visions of the Future (1/20): Penglai, Island of the Immortals
note_en: 不是…而是… means "not X, but Y": Xiao Le's closing thought, 重要的不是永远活着，而是让这段生活变得有意义, rejects one idea and puts another in its place. Unlike English, which can just say "not this but that," Chinese normally marks both halves, with 不是 before the rejected idea and 而是 before the preferred one.
